transport_use: Frozen method-only material. Do not transport full dossiers, holdings, case narratives, later views or outcomes to historical decision workers.

rules.name: Business cash valuation
rules.source_faithful_method_paraphrase: Intrinsic value is an estimate of discounted extractable future cash. Owner earnings require maintenance investment and necessary working capital, with estimation uncertainty.

author_adaptation.origin: auditor operationalization, not claimed investor procedure
operational_steps: Reconcile earnings to cash available after maintenance spending and working capital. Separate expansion investment.
Write bear/base/bull cash paths, competitive assumptions and discount-rate sensitivity; report a range.
Reject precision unsupported by accounting or business knowledge.
author_adaptation.fits: Durable cash businesses with estimable reinvestment
author_adaptation.does_not_fit: Mechanical low P/E, EBITDA-only or book-value screens

method_specific_locators: Owner manual Intrinsic Value appendix opening definition and estimate-sensitivity paragraphs.

rules.name: Competence and durability
rules.source_faithful_method_paraphrase: An understandable business and the boundaries of competence matter. Selected technology-mediated businesses can be evaluated through their specific customer economics.

author_adaptation.origin: auditor operationalization, not claimed investor procedure
operational_steps: Explain who pays, why customers stay, and what change destroys earning power.
List the strongest evidence against the franchise and explicit unknowns.
Use no-fit or too-hard when crucial assumptions are ungrounded.
author_adaptation.fits: Business-specific knowledge including selected technology-mediated consumer franchises
author_adaptation.does_not_fit: Automatic sector stereotypes or prediction of every technology winner

method_specific_locators: 1996 letter Common Stock Investments competence-boundary paragraphs.
2017 original meeting archive afternoon section12, consumer-business discussion.

rules.name: Capital allocation economics
rules.source_faithful_method_paraphrase: Retained capital and repurchases need economic justification. Repurchase effects depend on price versus intrinsic value and underlying earnings, not share-count reduction alone.

author_adaptation.origin: auditor operationalization, not claimed investor procedure
operational_steps: Model business earnings independently of share-count reduction.
Price buybacks against intrinsic value and retained-capital alternatives.
Audit whether repurchases mask erosion of total cash generation.
author_adaptation.fits: Companies with meaningful reinvestment, buyback or dividend choices
author_adaptation.does_not_fit: EPS growth treated as sufficient proof of improved enterprise economics

method_specific_locators: Owner manual principles7 and9, debt/retained-capital economic justification.
2011 letter printed p6/PDF page5, Share Repurchases first two condition paragraphs and excess-cash/dilution warning, rendered lines219–227.

rules.name: Survival and financing
rules.source_faithful_method_paraphrase: Preserve financing strength and liquidity appropriate to liabilities. Working liquidity, an absolute minimum and a purpose-specific repurchase condition are distinct constraints.

author_adaptation.origin: auditor operationalization, not claimed investor procedure
operational_steps: Map obligations, currency, funding tenor, insurance stress and liquidity before sizing.
Stress forced-sale risk rather than borrow against expected price stability.
Use actual capital and liability constraints; keep working liquidity, an absolute minimum and purpose-specific conditions separate without importing a universal or current numeric amount.
author_adaptation.fits: Long-duration investment capital compatible with liability profile

method_specific_locators: Owner manual principle7 conservative financing paragraph.
2011 letter printed p18/PDF page17 liquidity-purpose paragraph; printed p6/PDF page5 separate repurchase-condition paragraph.

rules.name: Good business and price are separate
rules.source_faithful_method_paraphrase: Management or business quality does not remove the need for a justified price and a defensible normalized-earnings estimate.

author_adaptation.origin: auditor operationalization, not claimed investor procedure
operational_steps: Estimate normalized earnings over a full demand cycle.
Test downside from customer concentration, orders, margins and maintenance spending.
Record business-quality assessment separately from price, then revisit both after adverse evidence.
author_adaptation.fits: Cyclical high-quality businesses only at adequately risk-compensating valuation
author_adaptation.does_not_fit: Admiration for management used to waive valuation discipline

method_specific_locators: 2020 letter printed p4, pricing versus business quality and normalized-profit-estimation diagnosis paragraphs.

rules.name: Business model and culture filters
rules.source_faithful_method_paraphrase: Business model and corporate culture are separate filters. A profitable trade does not establish that the decision met those filters.

author_adaptation.origin: auditor operationalization, not claimed investor procedure
operational_steps: Explain how the business can keep producing cash and what the investor must understand.
Test culture with product choices, customer treatment, commitments and governance behavior, not slogans alone.
Record failed model or culture filters even if a past trade made money.
author_adaptation.fits: Businesses whose customer value and incentives can be examined
author_adaptation.does_not_fit: Profit on a trade used as proof the decision was sound

method_specific_locators: Fanglue rendered lines367–378, model/culture filters and decision quality.

rules.name: Future cash and opportunity cost
rules.source_faithful_method_paraphrase: Understanding a company includes understanding future cash generation. Expected investment economics are judged against opportunity cost.

author_adaptation.origin: auditor operationalization, not claimed investor procedure
operational_steps: Compare a conservative future cash-flow range with price and investable alternatives.
Separate company admiration from expected return at the chosen price.
Avoid importing exact historic multiples or a cash balance remembered many years later.
author_adaptation.fits: Long-lived cash generation with comprehensible uncertainty
author_adaptation.does_not_fit: Fixed PE rule, cheapness alone or guaranteed upside claims

method_specific_locators: Fanglue rendered line267, future cash understanding; line412, future earnings and opportunity cost.

rules.name: Competence before conviction
rules.source_faithful_method_paraphrase: Business-specific experience and knowledge limits matter. Selective public positions and small learning stakes do not establish complete disclosure or conviction sizing.

author_adaptation.origin: auditor operationalization, not claimed investor procedure
operational_steps: Link each major assumption to firsthand operating understanding or dated primary evidence.
Label uncertainty and observation positions; do not treat any public buy as conviction size.
Choose sizing from independent loss capacity and liquidity, never from an assumed percentage of the investor’s undisclosed wealth.
author_adaptation.fits: Concentrated research when competence and capital capacity are established
author_adaptation.does_not_fit: Blind copying, full-net-worth inference from one account’s exposure

method_specific_locators: Fanglue rendered lines307–309, specific operating knowledge/account capital capacity; line386, selective disclosure and learning stakes.

rules.name: Instrument economics and correction
rules.source_faithful_method_paraphrase: Daily correlation does not establish long-run instrument tracking. Understand the economic mechanism and stop perpetuating a recognized mistake.

author_adaptation.origin: auditor operationalization, not claimed investor procedure
operational_steps: Read legal instrument structure, daily-reset or roll exposure, carry, decay and long-run tracking before entry.
Separate belief in oil demand from the return delivered by an index product.
Specify an immediate reconsideration trigger when the economic mechanism is misunderstood; recognize sunk cost without needing price recovery.
author_adaptation.fits: Understandable instruments supporting an independently formed thesis
author_adaptation.does_not_fit: Long-term holding of a product whose tracking mechanism is unknown

method_specific_locators: Fanglue rendered lines382–383, daily correlation versus long-run tracking and correction of recognized mechanism error.

rules.name: Epistemic audit before valuation
rules.source_faithful_method_paraphrase: Distinguish known, unknown, unnecessary-to-know and unknown-unknown risks. Engage the strongest contrary argument and leave crucial ununderstood situations too hard.

author_adaptation.origin: auditor operationalization, not claimed investor procedure
operational_steps: Separate known, unknown, irrelevant-to-thesis and potential unknown-unknown risks.
Write the strongest contrary explanation using its best evidence.
Reject a crucial assumption lacking a defensible evidence path rather than fill it with a sector stereotype.
author_adaptation.fits: Deeply understood businesses with honest uncertainty ranges
author_adaptation.does_not_fit: A fluent narrative masking an essential knowledge gap

method_specific_locators: Columbia Spring2013 printed p25 opposing-argument paragraph; p30 too-hard bucket; pp31–32 intellectual-honesty categories.

rules.name: Moat and adaptive culture
rules.source_faithful_method_paraphrase: Repeated problem-solving and an adaptive culture can be relevant business evidence. Rapid change still makes forecasts harder and outcomes uncertain.

author_adaptation.origin: auditor operationalization, not claimed investor procedure
operational_steps: Test concrete repeatable problem-solving, organizational learning, incentives and customer value.
Separate what was proved at the decision date from what management accomplished later.
Price the range of outcomes with a margin for mechanisms not yet understood.
author_adaptation.fits: Selected changing industries where investor competence is adequate
author_adaptation.does_not_fit: Excluding every technology business or treating policy support as a guaranteed moat

method_specific_locators: Columbia Spring2013 printed p28, repeatable engineering/problem-solving paragraph; p31, adaptive-culture/change paragraphs.

rules.name: Opportunity-cost portfolio construction
rules.source_faithful_method_paraphrase: Cash and existing holdings form an opportunity-cost comparison. Improve the portfolio’s risk-adjusted economics; a better alternative can justify selling.

author_adaptation.origin: auditor operationalization, not claimed investor procedure
operational_steps: Compare candidate risk-adjusted economics with cash and current holdings.
Explain the marginal improvement to the whole portfolio rather than chase a target country weight.
Reassess a holding when a superior alternative or new adverse evidence changes the comparison.
author_adaptation.fits: Patient concentrated research with long-duration compatible capital
author_adaptation.does_not_fit: Forced deployment, fixed geographic quota or never-sell dogma

method_specific_locators: Columbia Spring2013 printed pp28–29 opportunity-cost/cash/geography paragraphs; p32, superior-alternative sale paragraph.

rules.name: Avoid strategy risk incompatible with the mandate
rules.source_faithful_method_paraphrase: A correct thesis can fail financially under adverse strategy economics. Shorting adds asymmetric loss, borrowing persistence and attention costs incompatible with the later long-owner framework.

author_adaptation.origin: auditor operationalization, not claimed investor procedure
operational_steps: Separate being factually right from surviving until prices recognize it.
Stress unlimited-loss, borrow-cost/recall and attention costs when evaluating a short strategy.
Do not apply the mature long-owner method to the investor’s earlier long/short era without an explicit era tag.
author_adaptation.fits: Long business ownership compatible with understanding and loss capacity
author_adaptation.does_not_fit: Assuming past shorting practice is a current endorsed skill

method_specific_locators: Columbia Spring2013 printed pp26–27, short-strategy asymmetry/borrowing/attention-risk paragraphs.

worker_payload_content_boundary: Only the 13 rules’ source-faithful method paraphrases, dated original provenance, method-specific locators and separately labelled adaptations. No rich claim records, security positions, named case narratives, case success/error labels, monetary outcomes or current views are included.
